info.title: SafeSite API
info.description:
SafeSite MVP backend — hazard reporting for Plant X.

**Auth:** call `POST /v1/auth/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.

**Report flow (one-tap widget):**
1. `POST /v1/uploads` for the photo and the voice note → PUT the bytes to `uploadUrl`.
2. `POST /v1/incidents` with the keys. The voice note is transcribed inline with
   Amazon Transcribe **Streaming**, embedded with Amazon Bedrock Titan, and clustered
   (cosine similarity) under an existing parent incident before the call returns.

**Versioning:** every edit / approval / rejection appends an immutable version node.
Mutations must send `expectedVersion`; a stale value returns **409 STALE_VERSION**.

**Generative AI disclosure:** speech-to-text (Amazon Transcribe) and text embeddings
(Amazon Bedrock Titan) are used for transcription and duplicate detection; PPE checks use
Amazon Rekognition. Responses flag `isMock` when the offline fallback is active.

kind.description: photo: image/jpeg|png. audio: 16 kHz mono WAV (PCM 16-bit), FLAC or OGG/Opus — the formats Transcribe Streaming accepts. blueprint: managers only.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size; it is signed into the URL

imageUrl.description: Short-lived URL of the floor plan image

GeoBounds.description: GPS corners of a north-up blueprint, for auto-pinning

replayed.description: true if this clientSubmissionId was already saved

transcript.description: Machine transcription of the voice note

clientSubmissionId.description: Generated ONCE per tap on the device and reused on retries (idempotency key)

audioKey.description: Key from POST /v1/uploads (kind=audio). Transcribed inline via Transcribe Streaming.

gps.description: Device GPS; auto-drops an estimated pin when no manual pin is given

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page

expectedVersion.description: The incident version the client last saw. The request fails with 409 STALE_VERSION if someone changed the report since.

post.description:
Upload media first via POST /v1/uploads. The voice note is transcribed inline with Amazon Transcribe Streaming, embedded, and auto-clustered against open incidents — all before this call returns. Safe to retry with the same clientSubmissionId.

**Roles:** WORKER, SUPERVISOR, MANAGER
